show_products.label: Show products in the till
show_products.description: Products show up when the Inventory app is active. Turn it off to sell only services or free-price lines.

show_services.label: Show services in the till
show_services.description: Services show up when the Services app is active. Turn it off to sell only products.

require_customer.label: Require a customer on every sale

max_discount_percent.label: Largest discount a cashier may give alone, per discount (%)
max_discount_percent.description: Each discount is checked on its own: a line's, the ticket's or a fixed amount. Above this, only a manager can give it and the check records who authorised it. Discounts can be combined, so the customer's total saving can be higher. 100 = no limit.

auto_invoice_with_tax_id.label: Issue an invoice when the customer has a tax ID

receipt_header.label: Receipt header
receipt_header.description: First line = name; the rest = address.

receipt_marketing_url.label: Promotional QR URL
receipt_marketing_url.description: Google reviews, social media, your website… Empty = no promotional QR.

receipt_marketing_text.label: Promotional QR text
receipt_marketing_text.description: For example «Scan and leave us a review».
